caption: The drawing displays a detailed section of a textile design in shades of blue and white, labeled as a "HAND WOVEN WOOL BED QUILT." The main pattern consists of alternating blocks of large, radiating floral motifs and groupings of leaves and smaller flowers. In the left section, there is a boxed area containing the text: "WILLIAM YERGIN WAYNE COUNTY OHIO 1852," surrounded by geometric and floral designs. The upper left and lower left corners contain border motifs with repeated floral and geometric elements. The bottom section includes a horizontal band of symmetrical, stylized flower and leaf forms with basket-like patterns. The drawing is rendered with intricate, consistent use of blue coloring to fill the background areas, leaving the motifs and text in white. The text at the bottom reads "SCALE 1/3 ACTUAL SIZE" and "CORNER DETAIL." The design's overall composition is structured with a clear emphasis on symmetry and repetition of shapes in a rectangular format.
title: Woven Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
